states.narration: Each product contains the same factor, a. Keep b and c in their original order.
Write a once outside the group. Distributing it again would recover both original products.

editorial.title: Find the shared factor
editorial.setup: Two products can share one piece of structure. Watch the repeated factor become the factor of a whole sum.
editorial.summary: Factoring is distribution read in the other direction. We did not divide by a, so this also works when a is zero.
